name: @blotto/scoring
description: The scoring engine (roadmap 2.1, R20): allocations, the 35-byte battle-set encoding, the all-vs-all engine, ranking with tie-breaks, prize amounts in 1024ths, the results Merkle tree, and the class digest (2.2). Pure functions, no I/O, no Date — one module that runs identically in the settlement crank (Node) and the verify page (browser).
